prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity mobile app UI design comp. Flat frontal screenshot of one phone screen at 390x845 viewport proportion.

Surface: The Ranger's Road, "Field Manual": the reference tab of a private, offline training app. It holds weekly leadership lessons, leadership principles, a reading list, Scripture references, field cards (tool inspection and three knots) and exercise guides. This layout is a contents page, like the table of contents of an issued field manual: part headings, indented entries, dotted leaders running to a right-aligned note, and this week's entries marked. It must read instantly as a working app screen whose entries open.

Reference image: it carries the visual world to keep exactly: header bar, warm paper page, serif plus sans pairing, hairline rules, bottom tab bar. Do NOT copy the reference's content (no watches, no measurements, no medallion rows); this screen is described below.

Layout, top to bottom:
1. Header bar as in the reference.
2. Large serif page title "Field Manual", and under it one sans line in secondary ink: "Chapter I · The Muster".
3. A full-width hairline.
4. The contents, set like a printed contents page. Part headings in serif, medium size, with a right-aligned sans note: "Leadership" ... "4 lessons"; under it indented serif entries, each joined by a fine dotted leader to a right-aligned sans note: "Lead yourself first" ... "Week 1"; "Keep small promises" ... "Week 2" with a small pine-filled tag "This week" after it; "Serve without an audience" ... "Week 3"; "Carry the details" ... "Week 4"; "Twelve principles" ... "Reference".
   Then part heading "Fieldcraft" ... "4 cards"; entries "Tool inspection" ... "Week 2" with the same small pine tag "This week"; "Square knot" ... "Week 3"; "Bowline" ... "Week 3"; "Two half hitches" ... "Week 3".
   Then part heading "Reading" ... "Now reading"; entry "Habits of the Household" ... "Wed and Fri".
   Then part heading "Scripture" ... "By week" (may run under the tab bar edge).
   Generous space above each part heading, tight spacing between entries, hairlines between parts.
5. Tab bar.

Text, verbatim and correctly spelled: "The Ranger's Road"; "Field Manual"; "Chapter I · The Muster"; "Leadership"; "4 lessons"; "Lead yourself first"; "Week 1"; "Keep small promises"; "Week 2"; "This week"; "Serve without an audience"; "Week 3"; "Carry the details"; "Week 4"; "Twelve principles"; "Reference"; "Fieldcraft"; "4 cards"; "Tool inspection"; "Square knot"; "Bowline"; "Two half hitches"; "Reading"; "Now reading"; "Habits of the Household"; "Wed and Fri"; "Scripture"; "By week"; "Keep"; "Road"; "Forge"; "Journal".
Palette only: Night Forest #172B21 for the header bar, Pine #24362B for selected options and small "This week" marks, warm paper #F6F3EA page, Parchment Tint #E9E5D8 for quiet panels, Medallion #E2DBCB for round icon grounds, Gold Ink #9C7442 for the icons inside medallions, rules #D4D1C7, Gold Line #A9804A only as the selected tab's short underline, Ink #171A17, Secondary Ink #4F514D, Sage label gray #53655C. Flat surfaces with 1px borders and 6px corners, no shadows.
Type: a sturdy bracketed book serif for the page title, section headings, entry names and all numerals; a narrow humanist sans for descriptions, help lines, inputs and buttons. No decorative fonts. No small uppercase label lines above headings.
Top of the screen: the same dark forest header bar as the reference, with the small gold three-pine mark and "The Ranger's Road" in cream serif. Bottom: the same five-tab bar as the reference, "Keep", "Road", "Forge", "Journal", "Field Manual", with "Field Manual" selected (pine text and folded-map icon, short gold underline).
Avoid: photos, forest scenery, maps, route lines, charts, progress bars or rings, percentages, XP, points, streaks, badges, checkmarks of completion, fake parchment texture, ornament, glow, 3D, device frame, status bar, hands, book covers, Bible verse text.
